markers.name: Orange entrance in I; Purple entrance in II

markers.to: I ↔ III; Orange wing joins the shared approach
II ↔ III; Purple wing joins the shared approach

uncertain: Dashed corridors preserve the documented route order but not unverified tunnel bends, subsidiary loops or ledge geometry.
Veng and Maraudos patrol; Q1 and Q4 mark approximate search areas. Q3 marks a plant-search area, not one fixed plant.
Meshlok is rare and mobile; marker 4 is approximate.
notes: Start Orange, visit Purple by backtracking from the shared approach, then descend toward Celebras.
The gap and downward arrow before Celebras denote a one-way ledge drop.
Q6 also marks the Legends of Maraudon hand-in; the ritual altar’s exact position is omitted.
Exterior caves, Cavindra, the vial-filling pool and the first three khans are outside these instance sheets.
